summary: Utah State beat Washington State 17-16 after trailing 16-3 at halftime. Cunningham’s two forced fumbles set up both touchdowns, but the offense and costly penalties still need work. The bye comes before an October 24 trip to Texas State.

items.headline: Utah State erased a 13-point halftime deficit to beat Washington State 17-16
items.tldr: The Cougars went scoreless after halftime. Utah State has its first Pac-12 win; the comeback gives the bye a better starting point without erasing the first-half problems.

items.headline: Cunningham forced two fumbles that became Utah State touchdowns
items.tldr: He finished with 17 tackles, and both recoveries gave the offense a short field. That defensive contribution decided the game; keep it separate from the offense’s ability to sustain a drive.

items.headline: Brosterhous completed 11 of 26 passes in Friday’s win
items.tldr: Both touchdown drives started in Washington State territory. The bye should be about finding completions and first downs that let the offense score without needing another takeaway.

items.headline: Mendenhall says his own penalty needs correcting
items.tldr: The coach’s personal foul helped push a drive out of field-goal range. Utah State also extended a Washington State scoring drive with a post-play penalty; the bye needs a cleaner response to the whistle.

items.headline: Utah State plans field-level suites for the 2027 season
items.tldr: The end-zone suites will have 10-16 seats. Pricing and the number available are still to come; fans interested in next season can use the athletics department’s interest form.

lead.headline: Build drives without the short field.
lead.body: The defense supplied the comeback’s two touchdown opportunities. Use the bye to improve the next completion, the handoff and the decision after the whistle, so the offense can earn a scoring drive of its own.

matchup.thesis: Turn the comeback into cleaner possessions
matchup.question: What should Utah State carry into the bye?
matchup.answer: Keep the defensive pursuit that produced the turnovers, then work on the offense’s next first down. Clean up the post-play penalties and kick-return exchange before the October 24 trip to Texas State.

signals.summary: Finish the play without the penalty
signals.detail: Utah State lost 87 yards to penalties Friday. Protect the kick-return exchange and leave the whistle alone after a stop; the defense should keep the field position it earns.
